description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial disputes between Mrs.H. B. G. Rakumthala, Group of employees inclusive of Uluwitike and other part Southern Provincial Road Development Authority, Galle - The Industrial disputes between W. K. A. Arachchi, Pallewela and other part Sri Lanka Catering Limited, Airline Center, Katunayaka
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. While it mentions a government minister (Manusha Nanayakkara), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing government personnel changes or structural reforms. The core content is about legal procedures for dispute resolution under established labor laws.
